services.desc: Let your kids experience the excitement and energy of our Capoeira classes without any cost. Their first class is on the house, so they can discover the world of Capoeira in a fun and welcoming environment. More info: Please call / whatsapp or text 778 838 9801. Email us at: info.achebrasil@gmail.com. We offer classes to children (ages 4 to 12), youth over 13 years old may take the Youth and the Adult classes. Capoeira Aché Brasil highlights strength, coordination, flexibility and agility. We emphasize positive energy and improving one's health, confidence and well being.
